title.narrative: NIHR Global Health Research Group on developing strategies for hepatitis C in Ethiopia (DESTINE) Project

description.narrative: The DESTINE project — officially known as the NIHR Global Health Research Group on Developing Strategies for Hepatitis C in Ethiopia — is a collaborative initiative led by Addis Ababa University, College of Health Sciences, in partnership with institutions in Ethiopia and the United Kingdom. The project aims to: • Generate essential epidemiological data, mathematical modeling, and models of care tailored to the Ethiopian context • Provide evidence to guide strategic planning for hepatitis C virus (HCV) healthcare services in Ethiopia • Support Ethiopia’s contribution to the UN Sustainable Development Goals and the WHO global target of eliminating HCV as a public health threat by 2030 • Build sustainable research capacity and skills in major Ethiopian medical schools
